title: Liquidity partnership manager (latam)
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for an LP Partnership Manager to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across key regions. This role will be instrumental in sourcing, onboarding, and managing LP partners, while working closely with the trading team to optimize liquidity, pricing, and execution.

The ideal candidate is highly connected within the local market, with a strong network of liquidity providers and a deep understanding of regional payment and banking landscapes.

Key Responsibilities

Business Development & Partnerships Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers Evaluate LP quality (pricing, depth, reliability, regions covered) Negotiate trading terms (spreads, fees, credit lines, margin terms)

Market & Network Development Leverage existing network to expand LP coverage in key regions (APAC, LATAM, Africa) Maintain strong relationships with banks, payment providers, and liquidity partners Stay up to date with local market dynamics, pricing trends, and competitive landscape

Execution & Collaboration Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, and execution quality Coordinate with internal teams to onboard LPs and ensure smooth operational setup Support ongoing performance monitoring and optimization of LP relationships

Banking & Infrastructure Setup Facilitate opening of bank accounts and payment rails required for LP operations Identify suitable partners to support local currency flows and settlement

Requirements 5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, or liquidity management Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, or related financial services Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, and payment partners Proven ability to source and onboard LPs in local markets Strong understanding of regional market structures and liquidity dynamics Must have strong, deep LP network in at least one of the following regions: LATAM

Vision & Mission OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a Pay Fi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2 B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and Stable X, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Member of the board of advisors
description:
About the Company

Founded in 1950, Westfield FC has been an important part of its local football community for more than 75 years. Today, the club competes in the 8th tier of English football and is backed by an ambitious group of investors committed to building a sustainable, community-driven club with long-term growth potential. Our vision is to earn promotion through the English football pyramid and ultimately reach the English Football League through strategic investment, strong leadership, and community engagement. Westfield FC also competes in FA Cup and FA Trophy qualifying matches each season, providing exciting opportunities to showcase the club on a national stage while pursuing success both on and off the pitch.

Company Website:

About the Role: Member of the Board of Advisors

Westfield FC is seeking accomplished professionals, entrepreneurs, sports executives, investors, and football enthusiasts to join our Board of Advisors. Advisors will help promote the club, expand our network, identify strategic opportunities, and support the long-term growth of Westfield FC. This is an opportunity to become part of an ambitious ownership group working to build a successful football club for generations to come.

We are also actively seeking advisors from Brazil to help represent and support Westfield FC within their local market and networks.

Key Responsibilities

Promote Westfield FC within your professional and personal network. Introduce potential sponsors, commercial partners, investors, and strategic relationships. Provide strategic guidance on club growth, marketing, fundraising, commercial partnerships, and community engagement. Support revenue-generating and brand-building initiatives when appropriate. Participate in periodic advisory meetings and provide feedback on key priorities.

Preferred Qualifications Passion for football and the business of sports. Experience as an executive, entrepreneur, investor, advisor, or business leader. Strong professional network that can support club growth. Interest in sports investing, football operations, sponsorships, or community development. Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.

Compensation & Benefits

This advisory role offers sweat equity aligned with advisor contributions and the long-term success of Westfield FC. Advisors will have the opportunity to help shape the strategic direction of the club, work alongside the ownership group, expand their network within the football industry, and participate in an exciting football investment journey.

Why Join Us

Join an ambitious ownership group building a historic football club with a bold long-term vision. Inspired by stories like Welcome to Wrexham , our goal is to build a sustainable, community-focused club capable of climbing the English football pyramid and ultimately reaching the English Football League. If you’ve ever wanted to help shape the future of a football club from the inside while sharing in its long-term success, this is a unique opportunity.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Westfield FC is an equal opportunity organization. We are committed to creating a diverse, inclusive, and respectful environment and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Selection decisions are based on qualifications, merit, business needs, and the ability to contribute to the responsibilities of the advisory role.

title: Senior business analyst
description:
Senior Business Analyst

Role Overview

The Information Management Team at our corporate client uses industry best practices to deliver analytical platforms, data management capabilities, and business intelligence solutions that support business needs. The team works closely with business stakeholders to understand their objectives, translate requirements into practical technology solutions, and improve the efficiency and quality of services delivered to customers.

The Senior IT Business Analyst will serve as the primary liaison between international business stakeholders and technology delivery teams. This person will be responsible for understanding business needs, documenting requirements, supporting solution delivery, and helping business and technical teams maintain a shared understanding of project goals.

The ideal candidate has strong business analysis and project delivery experience within an IT environment. Experience supporting data teams, data platforms, reporting initiatives, business intelligence solutions, or data-related projects is preferred. The Business Analyst should be comfortable working with technology teams and discussing technical concepts but is not required to be a hands-on technical specialist, developer, or advanced SQL user.

Principal Duties and Responsibilities Serve as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, technology teams, and project team members. Lead and support requirements-gathering sessions with business stakeholders and subject matter experts. Understand business objectives, processes, challenges, and desired outcomes. Translate business needs into clear, complete, and actionable business and functional requirements. Develop and maintain business requirements documents, functional requirements, process flows, use cases, user stories, acceptance criteria, and related project documentation. Facilitate structured walkthroughs and reviews of requirements with business stakeholders and project team members. Work with business and technology teams to clarify requirements, resolve questions, and maintain alignment throughout the project lifecycle. Evaluate business requests to determine scope, feasibility, dependencies, risks, and potential solution options. Support projects involving data, reporting, business intelligence, data warehousing, or information management. Work with business stakeholders to define reporting needs, business rules, data definitions, and expected outcomes. Assist business and technology teams in identifying data-related issues and documenting potential solutions. Support the development and refinement of project backlogs, user stories, and acceptance criteria. Participate in project planning, sprint planning, backlog refinement, demonstrations, retrospectives, and other Agile ceremonies. Support user acceptance testing by developing test scenarios, coordinating business participation, documenting results, and tracking issues through resolution. Assist with change management, implementation planning, troubleshooting, and post-production support activities. Proactively identify opportunities to improve business processes, project delivery, service quality, and operational efficiency. Encourage collaboration and help establish a shared understanding of evolving business requirements and project needs. Communicate project updates, risks, decisions, dependencies, and outstanding issues to appropriate stakeholders. Manage multiple assignments, priorities, stakeholders, and deadlines in a changing project environment. Maintain regular and predictable attendance. Perform other duties as assigned.

Job Specifications

Education and Experience

Required Education and Experience Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience. Minimum of 5 years of experience as a Business Analyst, IT Business Analyst, Systems Analyst, or Technical Business Analyst. Experience gathering, analyzing, documenting, and managing business and functional requirements. Experience working with business stakeholders and technology teams. Experience creating user stories, acceptance criteria, process documentation, and business requirements. Experience working in an Agile, Scrum, or similar environment.

Preferred Experience supporting data teams or working on data-related projects. Experience with data warehousing, reporting, analytics, business intelligence, data integration, or data management initiatives. General familiarity with structured data, data quality, reporting requirements, and business rules. Experience with reporting or business intelligence tools such as Tableau or Business Objects. Experience with data modeling tools such as Erwin. Insurance or financial services industry experience. Six Sigma certification or process-improvement experience.

Skills and Abilities

Required Strong business analysis, requirements-gathering, and documentation skills. Ability to understand business processes and translate business needs into viable technology solutions. Ability to work effectively with both business and technical stakeholders. General understanding of technology projects, systems, data flows, integrations, reporting, and software delivery processes. Ability to facilitate meetings, requirements sessions, workshops, and cross-functional discussions. Strong interpersonal and relationship-management skills. Strong investigative, analytical, and problem-solving abilities. Strong oral and written communication skills. Ability to explain business requirements and technology concepts to audiences with different levels of technical knowledge. Ability to create clear user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and functional documentation. Detail orientation and the ability to deliver accurate, high-quality work. Ability to work effectively within an Agile team environment. Ability to organize and manage multiple tasks, clients, projects, priorities, and deadlines simultaneously. Ability to quickly adapt to new processes, systems, teams, and methods. Ability to work through ambiguity and evolving requirements. Ability to appropriately balance priorities, deadlines, risks, and project deliverables.

Technical Expectations

The Senior IT Business Analyst should be comfortable working in a technology environment and collaborating with developers, data engineers, architects, quality assurance professionals, and reporting teams. The position does not require the individual to be a developer, data engineer, or advanced technical specialist.

Basic familiarity with SQL, databases, reporting systems, data warehousing, or data analysis is beneficial, but the primary emphasis of the role is business analysis, stakeholder communication, requirements management, process understanding, and successful project delivery.

title: Video editor
description:
About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel e Commerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 75 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle: from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.

Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.

The Role

We are seeking a talented Video Editor to create high-performing video content for paid social advertising campaigns. You will edit engaging, conversion-focused video ads for Meta, Tik Tok, and Instagram Reels while working closely with our creative strategists and design team. This role requires fast turnaround capabilities, a keen understanding of performance creative principles, and the ability to manage multiple client projects simultaneously in a fully remote environment.

What Success Looks Like Consistently high video output with exceptional quality and attention to detail Strong creative performance metrics (CTR, watch time, engagement) across your video portfolio Seamless collaboration with creative strategists, designers, and media buyers to iterate and optimize Efficient project management and timely delivery across multiple concurrent client accounts

Responsibilities Edit high-performing video ads for paid social campaigns across Meta, Tik Tok, Instagram Reels, and You Tube Shorts Execute on creative briefs and storyboards developed by creative strategists Add motion graphics, text overlays, captions, and effects to enhance video storytelling and performance Work with raw UGC footage and branded content to create attention-grabbing, under-15-second video ads Iterate quickly on video concepts based on performance data and feedback from media buyers Maintain brand consistency across multiple client accounts while adapting to different brand voices Organize and manage video assets, project files, and creative libraries across all client accounts Stay current on platform trends, best practices, and format specifications for Tik Tok, Instagram Reels, and Meta Collaborate with creative strategists on video concepts and provide input on creative direction Conduct research on competitor ads and trending content to inform video creative approaches Pull and optimize stills from videos for ad thumbnails and static creative variations Participate in weekly design team meetings and collaborate with designers and fellow video editors

Requirements 2-4 years of video editing experience, preferably in performance marketing or advertising Expert proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and Adobe After Effects Motion graphics and animation capabilities Portfolio demonstrating social-first video work for paid advertising (Meta, Tik Tok, Instagram Reels) Strong understanding of performance creative principles and direct response video best practices Proven ability to work in a fast-paced environment with tight deadlines and high volume output Experience editing UGC (User Generated Content) and creator-style content Excellent attention to detail with strong quality control standards Fluent English communication skills for client collaboration and team coordination DTC or ecommerce experience working with product-focused brands Comfortable working remotely with distributed teams across multiple time zones

Nice to Have Experience with Cap Cut or other mobile-first editing tools Sound design and audio mixing skills Understanding of Tik Tok and Instagram Reels trends and viral content strategies Experience with color grading and advanced post-production techniques Basic design skills in Figma or Adobe Creative Suite Agency experience managing multiple concurrent client projects

Compensation and Benefits Fully Remote : Work from anywhere with flexible hours and a distributed team culture Generous Time Off : Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience

title: Immigration paralegal (immigration court / removal defense)
description:
Are you ready to build a meaningful career defending immigrants facing deportation? Do you thrive in fast‑paced environments, stay calm under pressure, and want to fight for people who need it most?

If so, Bueno Law wants to meet you.

About Bueno Law

Bueno Law is a Queer‑owned immigration law firm dedicated to protecting LGBTQ+ immigrants, survivors of domestic violence and human trafficking, and other marginalized communities.

We specialize in:

Removal Defense (EOIR). Asylum & Humanitarian Relief (U/T visas, VAWA, SIJS). Family‑Based Immigration.

We’re expanding our Removal Defense Team and seeking passionate, detail‑driven Paralegals committed to making a real impact.

What You’ll Do (Removal Defense Focus)

Support EOIR litigation by preparing filings, motions, briefs, and applications for relief (asylum, cancellation, waivers, adjustment, etc.). Draft client declarations and gather evidence for high‑stakes court submissions. Manage a removal‑defense caseload, track deadlines, and maintain accurate case records. Prepare hearing packets, organize exhibits, and assist attorneys with trial preparation. Communicate with clients—often in emotionally sensitive situations—to collect facts and provide updates. Coordinate with interpreters, experts, and agencies to support case strategy. Prepare and file USCIS petitions for clients with mixed EOIR/USCIS matters.

What We’re Looking For

Hard Skills

Fluent in English + Spanish or Portuguese. 3 years experience in with end to end removal defense (need experience with litigation). Strong legal writing, research, and evidence‑gathering skills. Highly organized and detail‑oriented with the ability to manage a heavy caseload. Tech‑savvy and fully equipped for remote work (computer, internet, private workspace, noise‑canceling headphones).

Soft Skills

Emotionally intelligent communicator who can support clients during stressful moments. Thrives in fast‑paced, mission‑driven environments. Team‑oriented, proactive, adaptable, and solutions‑focused. A sense of humor—because the work is intense, and we believe in supporting each other.

Preferred Qualifications

3 + years of immigration paralegal experience. Experience with both EOIR and USCIS filings.

What We Offer

Competitive pay above market rate. Paid vacation + sick leave. Your birthday off. U. S. paid holidays. Mon–Fri, 9 AM–6 PM PST. A mission‑driven, inclusive, supportive team.

title: Read back agent - portuguese/english (immigration legal services)
description:
About Bueno Law Corp

Bueno Law Corp is a mission‑driven immigration law firm dedicated to helping survivors of domestic violence, LGBTQ+ immigrants, and other vulnerable individuals build safe, stable lives in the United States. We provide compassionate, trauma‑informed representation while maintaining the highest standards of legal excellence.

About the Role

We’re seeking a Spanish‑speaking Read Back Agent to help clients fully understand the immigration work completed on their behalf. You’ll serve as a trusted communicator—summarizing case progress, explaining filings, and ensuring clients feel informed, supported, and empowered throughout their humanitarian or asylum process.

This role is ideal for someone who communicates with clarity, empathy, and professionalism, especially when working with vulnerable populations.

What You’ll Do

Conduct “read back” sessions with clients in native Portuguese , summarizing legal work completed on their cases Explain filings, evidence submissions, and next steps in clear, accessible language Translate complex legal concepts into client‑friendly explanations without altering meaning Confirm client understanding and address questions with patience and care Communicate internally in English with attorneys, paralegals, and case managers Document all client interactions accurately in the case management system Uphold trauma‑informed communication practices and strict confidentiality standards

What You Bring

Native or near‑native Portuguese fluency English fluency (spoken and written) Excellent verbal communication skills High attention to detail and strong listening skills Ability to stay calm, empathetic, and professional during sensitive conversations Experience with immigrant communities or legal services preferred Comfort working in a fast‑paced, mission‑driven environment Basic knowledge of immigration processes (training provided)

Core Strengths

Client‑centered communication Cultural sensitivity Reliability and accuracy Professionalism and integrity Team collaboration

Why This Role Matters

You’ll help clients understand life‑changing legal work during some of the most vulnerable moments of their lives. Your communication ensures they feel safe, informed, and supported—strengthening trust and improving outcomes.

What We Offer

Competitive pay Training designed to help you succeed Paid vacation, sick leave, and birthdays off U. S. paid holidays Clear, structured growth opportunities within the firm Fully remote, full‑time position

title: Ai filmmaker - especialista em criação de videos com ia
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) AI Filmmaker inovador(a), especializado(a) na criação de vídeos cinematográficos e fotorrealistas utilizando ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial Generativa e fluxos de produção híbridos. Esta posição combina os fundamentos da produção audiovisual tradicional com expertise em tecnologias de IA aplicadas à criação de vídeo. O(a) profissional ideal possui domínio de cinematografia, iluminação, linguagem de câmera, edição e narrativa visual, aliado a um profundo conhecimento de ferramentas de geração de vídeo por IA, fluxos de animação e pipelines de pós-produção. Inglês fluente é mandatório para esta vaga uma vez que trabalhamos em parceria com times internacionais.

Principais Responsabilidades: Conceber e produzir vídeos de alta qualidade gerados por IA com estética cinematográfica e realismo visual. Transformar roteiros, storyboards e briefings criativos em narrativas audiovisuais impactantes. Projetar e executar fluxos de produção baseados em IA, desde a pré-visualização até a entrega final. Dirigir performances virtuais, ambientes digitais e movimentos de câmera dentro de plataformas de IA. Aplicar princípios avançados de cinematografia, incluindo iluminação, composição, escolha de lentes, profundidade e dinâmica de movimento. Garantir continuidade visual entre planos, cenas e sequências. Integrar conteúdo gerado por IA com filmagens reais (live action), bancos de imagem e vídeo (stock footage), efeitos visuais (VFX) ou elementos 3 D, quando necessário. Gerenciar os processos de pós-produção, incluindo edição, correção de cor (color grading), integração de áudio e finalização. Explorar continuamente novos modelos de IA para geração de vídeo, buscando otimizar qualidade, consistência e eficiência dos resultados. Trabalhar em colaboração com diretores de criação, editores, estrategistas e equipes de produção para garantir alinhamento entre visão criativa e execução.

Competências Técnicas e Qualificações

Expertise em Cinematografia e Narrativa Visual Sólido domínio da linguagem cinematográfica, incluindo composição de planos, blocking, ritmo, enquadramentos e narrativa visual. Experiência em desenho de iluminação para diferentes estilos, como naturalista, estúdio e cinematográfico. Conhecimento de sistemas de câmera, lentes e estilos de movimentação (dolly, handheld, Steadicam e estética de drone). Capacidade de manter coerência narrativa, continuidade visual e impacto emocional em sequências geradas por IA. Excelente senso de edição, ritmo e estrutura narrativa.

Domínio de IA e Ferramentas Técnicas Experiência com as principais plataformas de geração de vídeo por IA. Domínio de técnicas avançadas de prompt engineering para controle de movimento, composição e direção de cenas. Conhecimento sobre consistência temporal, continuidade de personagens e métodos de controle de cenas. Experiência com fluxos de trabalho envolvendo compositing, inpainting, upscaling e interpolação de quadros (frame interpolation). Proficiência em softwares de edição de vídeo. Conhecimento em pipelines de color grading e acabamento cinematográfico. Familiaridade com a integração de conteúdos gerados por IA em fluxos tradicionais de pós-produção.

Experiência Desejável Formação ou experiência em cinema, produção audiovisual, cinematografia ou produção publicitária. Vivência em publicidade, branded content, campanhas para mídias sociais ou produções de curta duração. Conhecimento de fluxos de trabalho com efeitos visuais (VFX) e composição de movimento. Compreensão de aspectos éticos, direitos autorais e licenciamento relacionados à produção de conteúdo com IA. Experiência na criação de processos escaláveis e reutilizáveis para produção de vídeos utilizando Inteligência Artificial.

Competências Comportamentais Forte visão criativa aliada à excelência técnica. Alto nível de atenção aos detalhes, especialmente em continuidade de movimento e realismo visual. Capacidade de iterar rapidamente sem comprometer a clareza narrativa e a qualidade da produção. Facilidade para atuar em um ambiente dinâmico, acompanhando a rápida evolução das tecnologias de IA. Boa comunicação, sendo capaz de explicar e defender decisões criativas e técnicas de forma clara e objetiva.

Informações Adicionais:

Modelo de contratação: CLT

Modelo de trabalho: 100% Remoto

Horário de trabalho: Das 10h00 ás 19h00

O que oferecemos :

• Vale Refeição/Alimentação via cartão Swile;

• Assistência odontológica- opcional;

• Day Off de aniversário;

title: Business development & marketing
description:
About i QIYI

i QIYI International is a global digital entertainment platform focused on Asian dramas, films, animation, variety shows and other content for international audiences. In Brazil and Latin America, we are building partnerships with leading media, telecom, digital platforms and brands to make Asian entertainment more accessible to local audiences.

Role purpose

Support i QIYI’s expansion in Brazil and Latin America by prospecting, developing and coordinating commercial and marketing partnerships. The role requires the ability to independently organize priorities, lead meetings, prepare proposals, follow up on opportunities and coordinate projects with external partners and internal teams in Brazil, Canada and Asia, without constant supervision.

Key responsibilities

1. Business Development & Partnerships – approximately 70% Map, prospect and develop relationships with private and public free-to-air broadcasters, telecommunications operators, digital and OTT platforms, distributors, technology companies, payment providers, retailers, consumer brands and other strategic partners. Build and maintain an organized pipeline of potential partners in Brazil and other Latin American markets, documenting contacts, opportunity stages, next steps, risks and timelines. Prepare presentations, commercial proposals, preliminary partnership models, meeting minutes, progress reports and decision-support materials. Lead initial meetings, identify partner needs and develop value propositions suited to different cooperation models. Support negotiations involving content distribution, licensing, revenue sharing, subscription bundles, media/barter, co-marketing, customer benefits, promotions and other commercial models. Negotiate commercial terms within approved parameters and coordinate validation with the Country Manager and relevant i QIYI functions; final approvals and signatures remain with management and headquarters. Coordinate the progress of opportunities with internal content, marketing, product, technology, legal, finance, operations and other teams in Brazil, Canada and Asia. Support partnership implementation after approval, ensuring alignment on scope, deliverables, timelines and performance indicators. Conduct research on markets, competitors, potential partners and trends across streaming, television, telecommunications and entertainment in Latin America. Represent i QIYI in partner meetings, industry events and business visits, with availability for occasional travel within Brazil and Latin America.

2. Marketing Partnerships – approximately 30% Identify and structure marketing opportunities with commercial partners to promote the i QIYI brand, priority content launches and subscription offers. Plan and coordinate co-marketing initiatives, partner campaigns, events, activations, content promotion and online/offline promotional projects. Adapt global briefs and materials to the needs of Brazil and other Latin American markets, ensuring local relevance and compliance with brand guidelines. Coordinate deliverables with internal and external stakeholders, including partners, agencies, public relations teams, influencers and vendors when applicable. Track execution and results, gather evidence of delivery and prepare reports with learnings and recommendations.

Required qualifications At least 3 years of experience in business development, partnerships, commercial roles, partnership marketing or related functions. Hands-on experience in B2 B prospecting, relationship management, proposal preparation and follow-up of negotiations or partner projects. Fluent or native Portuguese. Professional English, with the ability to participate in meetings, prepare presentations and communicate with international teams. Demonstrated ability to work autonomously, set priorities, meet deadlines and keep stakeholders informed. Strong verbal and written communication, negotiation, organization and relationship-building skills. Availability to collaborate across time zones and travel occasionally within Brazil and Latin America. Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, International Relations, Economics or a related field. Proficiency in Power Point/Google Slides and Excel/Google Sheets; familiarity with CRM and project-management tools is preferred.

Preferred qualifications Experience in streaming, entertainment, television, media, telecommunications, technology or digital platforms. Professional Spanish for communication with partners across Latin America. Existing relationships with broadcasters, telecom operators, platforms, agencies, brands or other potential partners. Experience working in multicultural environments and with international headquarters or regional teams. Knowledge of licensing, revenue-share, subscription bundles, co-marketing and media/barter models. Mandarin Chinese. Experience working with Chinese companies and a strong understanding of Chinese corporate culture will be considered a distinct advantage.

Employment conditions and benefits Permanent CLT employment agreement. Initially remote work, with the possibility that the work model may be reviewed in the future, including hybrid or office-based arrangements, in accordance with business needs, company policy and applicable law. Quarterly bonus in accordance with company policy and individual/corporate performance. Health insurance plan, meal/food allowance and life insurance. 30 calendar days of paid annual leave, 13th-month salary, FGTS, INSS and other statutory benefits under Brazilian law. Applicable statutory leave and occupational health examinations.

title: Director of ecommerce
description:
Company: Lime Vizio Inc.

Industry: Multi-Brand E-Commerce (US & Canada)

Location: Remote (outside the US)

Schedule: Full-time, Los Angeles business hours

Reports to: CEO & Founders

About Lime Vizio

Lime Vizio is a multi-brand e-commerce company operating across the United States and Canada.

We build and grow digital businesses in flowers, gifting, and local services, processing thousands of orders through proprietary technology, performance marketing, AI, and operational excellence.

We're looking for an experienced E-Commerce Director to drive profitable growth—not just increase traffic.

About the Role

You'll own the end-to-end digital customer journey across multiple brands, from acquisition through checkout, retention, and repeat purchase.

This is a commercial leadership role focused on improving conversion, customer experience, merchandising, experimentation, and profitability.

Success is measured by business outcomes—not website activity.

What You'll Own E-commerce growth strategy Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) Customer journey & UX Merchandising & pricing Checkout optimization A/B testing & experimentation Retention (Email & SMS) SEO commercial performance AI-powered shopping experiences Cross-functional collaboration with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Design, Analytics, and Operations

Key Responsibilities Increase gross profit, conversion rate, AOV, retention, and profit per visitor. Build and execute the e-commerce growth roadmap. Lead CRO and experimentation programs. Improve customer experience across desktop and mobile. Optimize merchandising, pricing, promotions, bundles, and upsells. Improve customer retention and lifecycle marketing. Work with PPC and SEO teams to maximize profitable growth. Introduce AI-driven shopping and personalization where it creates measurable business value. Prioritize initiatives based on commercial impact rather than activity.

Success Metrics

You'll be accountable for measurable improvements in:

Gross Profit Profit per Visitor Conversion Rate Average Order Value Checkout Completion Repeat Purchase Rate Customer Lifetime Value Incremental Profit from Experiments

Requirements 7+ years in E-commerce, CRO, Growth, or Digital Commerce. 3+ years in an e-commerce leadership role. Strong in-house e-commerce experience (required). Proven success improving conversion, AOV, retention, or profitability. Experience leading CRO, experimentation, merchandising, and customer journey optimization. Strong understanding of unit economics and commercial performance. Experience working with Product, Engineering, PPC, SEO, Design, and Analytics teams. Excellent English (B2+). Available during Los Angeles business hours. Based outside the United States.

Nice to Have Multi-brand e-commerce Marketplace businesses High-volume online retail Woo Commerce or Shopify AI-powered personalization Behavioral psychology Seasonal or event-driven commerce

This Role Is Not for Someone Who Only manages website content. Focuses on traffic instead of profit. Relies entirely on agencies. Treats CRO as visual redesign. Reports problems without owning implementation. Measures success through clicks instead of commercial performance.

What We Offer Remote, long-term leadership role. Direct partnership with the CEO and founders. Ownership of commercial growth strategy. Fast decision-making with minimal bureaucracy. Opportunity to scale multiple e-commerce brands using data, experimentation, and AI.

title: Cloud coe solution architect lead
description:
Cloud Co E Solution Architect Lead at Mars Sao Paulo-Guararema

Join a $50 B+ global powerhouse driving the next generation of digital transformation

At Mars, we are a family-owned business operating in 80+ countries with over 150,000 Associates. Guided by our Five Principles—Quality, Responsibility, Mutuality, Efficiency, and Freedom—we are currently embarking on a massive Digital Core program to modernize our global technology landscape and build the future of our enterprise cloud capabilities

The Opportuni ty

This is not a passive advisory role. As our Cloud Co E Solution Architect Lead, you will serve as the premier technical authority, leading our Cloud ARB and shaping how unique, cutting-edge digital platforms deploy safely and elastically to the Mars global cloud

Your Strategic Role and Impact

Lead and Mentor: You will guide, mentor, and foster a collaborative, high-performance team of cloud architects Technical Governance: You will lead the Technical Design Authority (Cloud ARB) sessions to evaluate and approve advanced cloud architectures proposed by Mars’ Digital Platform Development team Standards and Compliance: You will enforce elasticity, scalability, and high availability standards while ensuring the seamless adoption of critical security and governance controls across all cloud workloads Backlog Prioritization: You will partner directly with SRE and digital platform teams to prioritize the enablement backlog and ensure it meets the business needs of the organizat ion.

What We Are Looking For Experience: You have 7+ years of experience as a Solution Architect with a focus on cloud architecture and design, with a proven track record of mentoring architects and driving decisions within a technical group. Technical Mastery: You possess proven, hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and its services, utilizing Infrastructure-as-Code (specifically Terraform) and version control (Git). Cloud Foundations: You demonstrate deep knowledge of cloud security principles, data modeling, application architecture, and system integration. Communication Excellence: You have the ability to translate complex cloud architecture into clear business value for both highly technical teams and senior business leaders. Educational Background: You hold a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical work experience. Additional Strengths: Experience with other cloud platforms like Azure or AWS, or familiarity with enterprise architecture frameworks like TOGAF, is highly valued .

What to Expect in This Role

Balancing Speed and Governance: The Cloud Co E is an enabler, not a bottleneck. Success means building robust landing zones that protect our enterprise systems while empowering developers to innovate at pace.

Complex Multi-Stakeholder Collaboration: You will be coordinating between developers, security officers, and business leaders. Clear, jargon-free communication is your primary tool for aligning vision .

What can you expect from Mars? Work with diverse and talented Associates, all guided by the Five Principles. Join a purpose-driven company, where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today. title: Microsoft fabric architect
description:
Position Overview

We are looking for an experienced MS Fabric Architect to design and implement modern data platforms using Microsoft Fabric and Azure. The role will be responsible for defining architecture best practices, data ingestion patterns, security and governance frameworks, CI/CD processes, and analytical solutions across SAP and non-SAP data sources. The position involves working with a U. S.-based client, so an advanced level of English is a mandatory requirement .

Key Responsibilities

Design scalable and secure Microsoft Fabric architectures aligned with data platform and business requirements. Define data ingestion and integration architectures for SAP and non-SAP data sources . Design and implement data pipelines using Fabric Data Factory . Design and optimize Fabric Lakehouses, Warehouses, and Delta Tables . Establish best practices for Fabric Workspaces , including workspace organization, environments, access, governance, and lifecycle management. Design security and authorization models following Microsoft and industry best practices. Configure and manage CI/CD Deployment Pipelines across development, testing, and production environments. Design and develop Semantic Models to support enterprise analytics and reporting. Build and optimize complex Power BI reports and dashboards . Define data architecture standards, patterns, and best practices across Fabric projects. Collaborate with data engineers, BI developers, business stakeholders, and other technical teams to ensure successful delivery of data and analytics solutions. Provide technical guidance and architectural leadership throughout the implementation lifecycle.

Required Skills & Experience

Strong experience with Microsoft Fabric architecture and the broader Azure data ecosystem. Hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric Data Factory . Experience designing data ingestion solutions from SAP and non-SAP sources . Strong knowledge of Fabric Lakehouses, Warehouses, and Delta Tables . Experience designing and implementing Semantic Models . Strong Power BI experience, including development of complex reports and dashboards. Experience with Fabric Workspace architecture, governance, security, and authorization . Experience configuring CI/CD and Fabric Deployment Pipelines . Understanding of enterprise data architecture, data governance, security, and Dev Ops best practices. Ability to translate business and technical requirements into scalable and maintainable data architectures. Fluent in english.

Preferred Qualifications

Microsoft certifications related to Azure, Microsoft Fabric, Data Engineering, or Power BI . Experience working in enterprise-scale data and analytics environments. Experience with SAP data integration and enterprise data platforms. Strong understanding of Azure security, identity, and access management concepts.

Key Technologies

Microsoft Fabric | Azure | Fabric Data Factory | Lakehouse | Warehouse | Delta Tables | Semantic Models | Power BI | Fabric Workspaces | CI/CD Deployment Pipelines | Data Governance | Security & Authorization | SAP & Non-SAP Data Sources

Esta é uma posição estratégica com ampla exposição à liderança global da AB In Bev, oferecendo a oportunidade de influenciar decisões de grande impacto, liderar iniciativas de transformação e contribuir diretamente para a criação de valor e crescimento sustentável da organização em escala mundial.

title: Logistics manager
description:
Key Responsibilities End-to-End Logistics Operations – Oversee the full chain from port arrival, customs clearance, container pick-up, inland transport, VMI warehousing, order outbound, to final delivery, and close exceptions effectively. Track vessel schedules, terminal status, and capacity; coordinate with forwarders, brokers, carriers, and customs to ensure smooth and compliant clearance; handle contingencies such as inspections, port congestion, and demurrage. Plan optimal routes and transport modes, monitor shipments in transit, and quickly respond to delays, damage, or rejections with emergency plans. VMI Warehouse Lifecycle Management – Manage receiving plans, inbound inspection, put-away, inventory control, cycle counts, and annual physical counts to ensure WMS/ERP data accuracy and physical inventory alignment. Maintain inventory health by handling damaged, mis-shipped, slow-moving, or obsolete goods, and propose improvement plans. Ensure outbound shipments meet customer requirements for timing, packaging, labeling, and batch control to support JIT delivery. Sales Collaboration & Customer Service – Act as the logistics point of contact, closely partnering with local sales teams to provide early feasibility assessments, lead-time, and cost commitments for orders and projects. Interface with end customers, synchronize logistics milestones, resolve delivery issues, and enhance customer experience. Collect market intelligence and front-end needs to continuously refine logistics strategies and service standards. Local Resource & Supplier Management – Build and maintain a reliable local network of service providers (customs brokers, trucking fleets, warehouses, terminals, clearance agents, bonded warehouses). Have strong sourcing and price comparison skills. Stay updated on local port rules, customs policies, freight rates, road restrictions, holiday impacts, and other critical information. Logistics Solution Design & Cost Control – Independently design tailor-made logistics solutions for key accounts or major projects, covering mode selection, route planning, warehousing/distribution strategy, risk contingencies, and cost estimation. Set regional logistics budgets, monitor port charges, clearance fees, transport costs, and warehouse expenses, and drive cost reduction and process optimization. Provide operational analysis and improvement reports to support headquarters’ decision-making. Compliance, Risk & System Building – Ensure all operations comply with local customs, trade, foreign exchange, tax, safety, and other regulatory requirements. Establish regional SOPs, exception handling mechanisms, and contingency plans to enhance team standardization and resilience. Regularly report risk points, improvement measures, and execution results. Data Reporting & System Maintenance – Produce regular KPI reports covering inbound timeliness, outbound accuracy, inventory accuracy, on-time delivery, exception rate, cost achievement, etc. Maintain logistics system data to ensure accuracy and traceability, supporting digital operations.

Qualifications

Basic Requirements Bachelor’s degree or above (full-time) 5+ years of hands-on logistics operations and management experience Deep knowledge of the full cycle: customs clearance, land transport, warehousing, and cross-border delivery Must have experience in VMI/HUB warehouse management

Core Competencies Strong local logistics network and connections with government/port/service providers; ability to access real-time information quickly Capable of independently designing logistics solutions, resolving complex issues, and working effectively under pressure Excellent cross-functional communication, sales coordination, customer engagement, and commercial negotiation skills

title: Estagiário de recursos humanos
description:
Estágio em Recursos Humanos

A Liu Gong Latin America está em busca de um(a) Estagiário(a) de Recursos Humanos para integrar nossa equipe e apoiar as iniciativas de Recrutamento & Seleção (R&S) e Treinamento & Desenvolvimento (T&D) . Sobre a Liu Gong Latin America

A Liu Gong Latin America (LGLA) foi fundada no Brasil em 2008 e é uma subsidiária integral do Grupo Liu Gong. Desde 2015 fabricando equipamentos no país, a Liu Gong vem crescendo nos mercados brasileiro e latino-americano. O negócio abrange a venda e manutenção de equipamentos e acessórios para máquinas de construção, soluções de financiamento, treinamento de clientes, consultoria técnica e outros escopos.

Os principais produtos incluem carregadeiras de rodas, escavadeiras, motoniveladoras, rolos compactadores, retroescavadeiras, caminhões rígidos e plataformas aéreas de trabalho. Além disso, a Liu Gong continua desenvolvendo a estrutura de sua fábrica e centro de treinamento localizado na cidade de Mogi Guaçu, além de escritórios comerciais em Campinas e Belo Horizonte, fortalecendo o corpo de profissionais e qualificando o portfólio de produtos.

Para saber mais sobre a Liu Gong, visite:

Principais Responsabilidades

Apoiar os processos de Recrutamento & Seleção, incluindo divulgação de vagas, triagem de currículos e contato com candidatos. Auxiliar no agendamento de entrevistas, testes e demais etapas dos processos seletivos. Atualizar e controlar informações dos processos seletivos em planilhas e sistemas. Apoiar a elaboração de relatórios e indicadores da área de R& S. Contribuir na organização e condução do processo de integração (onboarding) de novos colaboradores. Apoiar a logística de treinamentos presenciais e online, acompanhando listas de presença, materiais e infraestrutura. Auxiliar no controle de treinamentos obrigatórios e no acompanhamento das trilhas de desenvolvimento dos colaboradores. Dar suporte na criação de materiais, comunicados e campanhas internas relacionadas a T& D. Apoiar a aplicação e consolidação de avaliações e pesquisas de treinamento. Organizar documentos, registros e controles administrativos da área de Recursos Humanos. Auxiliar na atualização de procedimentos e instruções de trabalho. Prestar suporte às demais atividades da área conforme demanda.

✅ Requisitos

Obrigatórios Estar cursando ensino superior em Psicologia, Recursos Humanos, Administração ou áreas correlatas . Boa comunicação verbal e escrita. Capacidade de lidar com informações confidenciais de forma ética e responsável.

title: Brazil sourcing & procurement manager
description:
Job Responsibilities

1. Procurement Execution & Channel Management Source, inquire, compare and negotiate prices for corn, wheat, sorghum, soybeans, soybean meal and other products originating from Brazil and surrounding regions, and complete the full procurement process. Develop and maintain partnerships with local suppliers including farms, traders and ABCD companies, build stable supply channels, and conduct supplier access, evaluation and hierarchical management.

2. Market Analysis & Cost Control Monitor weather conditions, crop planting, local policies, exchange rates, logistics as well as spot and futures prices in Brazilian producing areas, and deliver weekly and monthly market analysis reports plus procurement strategy proposals. Optimize procurement costs under the premise of guaranteed quality and delivery schedule, and manage price fixing, basis and logistics expenses.

3. End-to-End Contract & Order Management Lead business negotiations, draft and review contracts, clarifying terms regarding quality, quantity, pricing, delivery, payment, inspection and claims. Track the whole process including order preparation, loading, customs declaration, document delivery and cargo arrival to ensure smooth performance, and handle abnormalities such as cargo damage, weight shortage and quality disputes.

4. Quality & Origin Control Cooperate with internal and third-party inspection institutions to conduct on-site sampling, testing and loading supervision, ensuring all products comply with China's import standards and internal company regulations. Keep track of quality differences across major Brazilian producing areas, and rationally arrange procurement regions and schedules.

5. Logistics & Warehousing Coordination Liaise with inland transporters, port warehouses, shipping agents and freight forwarders in Brazil to optimize cargo consolidation and sea transportation plans for better efficiency and lower costs. Collaborate with domestic teams of supply chain, finance, risk control and business departments for information synchronization, account reconciliation, settlement and document filing.

6. Compliance & Risk Management Abide by local labor, tax and trade laws and regulations in Brazil, as well as China's import quarantine and customs rules. Identify and prevent risks related to trade, exchange rate, compliance and contract performance. Keep complete business files to ensure full traceability and auditability.

7. Cross-regional Collaboration & Reporting Submit procurement ledgers, cost analysis, supplier reports, weekly and monthly market reports as required. Support domestic business planning and sales demands to maintain stable and sustainable supply.

Job Requirements

1. Education & Major Bachelor’s degree or above. Majors in International Trade, Logistics & Supply Chain, Agricultural Economics, Economics or related fields are preferred.

2. Work Experience At least 7 years of working experience in agricultural product procurement. Prior working experience in Brazil or practical experience with grain and oilseed businesses in South America is required. Candidates familiar with the industrial chains of corn, wheat, sorghum, soybeans and soybean meal are preferred.

3. Language Proficiency Fluent in Portuguese and English, capable of conducting business negotiations and reading & drafting contracts proficiently. Proficiency in Chinese is a plus.

4. Professional Competencies Well-versed in the full procurement workflow of bulk agricultural commodities, with solid knowledge of trade terms, contract clauses, quality inspection standards, port logistics and import compliance. Possess strong capabilities in market trend analysis, cost accounting, risk management and business negotiation. Proficient in Excel, ERP and procurement systems, and able to independently complete data analysis and report preparation.

5. Qualifications & Resources Hold valid legal working documents for Brazil. Existing supplier resources and connections with local farms and traders in Brazil are preferred. Relevant certificates for bulk commodity business or rich cross-border trade experience are an advantage.

6. Personal Qualities Willing to reside in Brazil on a long-term basis and accept frequent business trips and field work in producing areas. Able to work under pressure, with a rigorous, meticulous and principled work attitude. Possess excellent cross-cultural communication skills, team spirit and problem-solving abilities. Familiarity with Chinese culture is preferred.

Descrição das Responsabilidades do Cargo

1. Execução de compras e gestão de canais de abastecimento: Responsável pela prospecção de fontes, consulta de preços, comparação de cotações, negociação de valores e efetivação das compras de milho, trigo, sorgo, soja, farelo de soja e outras commodities produzidas no Brasil e regiões adjacentes. Desenvolver e manter parcerias com fornecedores locais, como fazendas, comerciantes de grãos e empresas multinacionais do ramo ABCD; estabelecer canais de suprimento estáveis e executar os processos de admissão, avaliação e classificação hierárquica dos fornecedores.

2. Análise de mercado e controle de custos: Acompanhar as condições climáticas, plantio, políticas governamentais, taxa de câmbio, logística e preços de contratos futuros e físicos nas regiões produtoras brasileiras, elaborar relatórios semanais e mensais de análise de mercado e propor estratégias de compras. Otimizar continuamente os custos de aquisição dentro dos padrões de qualidade e prazos de entrega, controlando os preços fixados, os spreads de base e os custos logísticos.

3. Gestão completa de contratos e pedidos: Conduzir negociações comerciais, elaborar e revisar contratos, definindo claramente cláusulas de qualidade, quantidade, preço, entrega, pagamento, inspeção de qualidade e indenizações por perdas. Acompanhar todo o fluxo dos pedidos, incluindo preparo de estoque, carregamento de navios, desembaraço aduaneiro, emissão de documentos e chegada da mercadoria ao porto de destino, garantindo o cumprimento contratual. Tratar incidentes como danificação da carga, falta de peso e contestações de qualidade.

4. Controle de qualidade e origem dos produtos: Colaborar com instituições de inspeção ou terceiros independentes para realizar amostragens, análises laboratoriais e supervisão do carregamento na origem, assegurando que os produtos atendam às normas de importação chinesas e aos controles internos da empresa. Conhecer as diferenças de qualidade entre as principais regiões produtoras do Brasil e planejar racionalmente as áreas de origem dos suprimentos e o ritmo das compras.

5. Coordenação de logística e armazenagem: Interagir com empresas de transporte terrestre interno do Brasil, depósitos portuários, agentes marítimos e despachantes aduaneiros, otimizar os planos de transporte até o porto e transporte marítimo, garantindo o melhor equilíbrio entre prazo logístico e custo. Colaborar com os departamentos nacionais de cadeia de suprimentos, finanças, gestão de riscos e operações comerciais para compartilhar informações, realizar conciliações de contas, efetuar pagamentos e arquivar documentos.

6. Gestão de conformidade e prevenção de riscos: Cumprir as leis trabalhistas, tributárias e comerciais brasileiras, além das normas de quarentena aduaneira e alfândega da China. Identificar e mitigar riscos comerciais, cambiais, de conformidade e de descumprimento contratual. Arquivar todo o conjunto de documentos operacionais para garantir rastreabilidade e auditoria completa.

7. Coordenação inter-regional e elaboração de relatórios: Apresentar regularmente planilhas de controle de compras, análises de custos, relatórios de fornecedores e relatórios semanais/mensais de mercado conforme exigido. Apoiar o planejamento comercial nacional e as demandas da equipe de vendas, garantindo suprimento contínuo e continuidade das operações.

Requisitos para a Vaga

1. Formação acadêmica: Graduação completa ou superior, com preferência para candidatos formados em Comércio Internacional, Logística e Cadeia de Suprimentos, Economia Agrícola, Economia e áreas correlatas.

2. Experiência profissional: Mínimo de 7 anos de experiência em compras de produtos agrícolas; experiência comprovada de trabalho no Brasil ou operacional com grãos e oleaginosas na América do Sul. Ter conhecimento completo da cadeia produtiva de múltiplas commodities (milho, trigo, sorgo, soja, farelo de soja) será um diferencial.

3. Habilidades linguísticas: Fluência em português e inglês, com capacidade irrestrita para negociações comerciais e leitura/redação de contratos. Domínio da língua chinesa será um diferencial.

4. Competências técnicas: Domínio completo de todo o fluxo de compras de commodities agrícolas; conhecimento aprofundado de termos comerciais internacionais, cláusulas contratuais, padrões de inspeção de qualidade, logística portuária e normas de conformidade para importação. Capacidade comprovada de análise de preços, cálculo de custos, gestão de riscos e negociação comercial. Proficiência em Excel, sistemas ERP e softwares de gestão de compras, com autonomia para análise de dados e elaboração de relatórios.

5. Qualificações e rede de contatos: Possuir autorização legal para trabalhar no Brasil. Ter rede de contatos com fornecedores na origem brasileira, como fazendas e comerciantes de grãos, será um diferencial. Certificações relacionadas a commodities ou experiência prática em comércio transfronteiriço também serão priorizadas.

6. Perfil comportamental: Disponibilidade para residir permanentemente no Brasil por longo prazo e aceitar viagens internacionais e deslocamentos regionais. Alta resistência à pressão, atenção aos detalhes e forte senso de ética. Excelente capacidade de comunicação intercultural, trabalho em equipe e resolução de problemas. Conhecimento da cultura chinesa será um diferencial.

title: Pesquisador doutor - markal - pesquisa e desenvolvimento em soluções de pulverização - doutores inovando no setor empresarial - iel pr
description:
A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo.

O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses, promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado, ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas.

Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico, favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico. A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências, e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável.

Sobre a Oportunidade:

Você deseja atuar no desenvolvimento de soluções voltadas à pulverização agrícola e contribuir para a evolução de produtos e componentes com alto impacto no campo? Esta é uma oportunidade estratégica para quem busca aplicar conhecimento avançado em engenharia de produto, detalhamento técnico e desenvolvimento aplicado, apoiando a MARKAL na criação e aprimoramento de projetos voltados ao desempenho, confiabilidade e eficiência operacional em aplicações agrícolas. Buscamos um profissional com visão sistêmica, capacidade analítica e forte domínio técnico para transformar requisitos em soluções viáveis, conduzir detalhamentos de projeto com precisão e garantir a qualidade da entrega por meio da elaboração de manuais técnicos e padronizações. Manage day‑to‑day assigned project tasks to complete various ERM deliverables. Analyze, formulate, propose, develop and/or contribute to overall solutions as per project deliverables. Continuous follow‑up of new market regulations/practices globally. Ability to utilize specialized knowledge on financial derivatives and Murex software to participate in implementation and upgrade projects throughout scoping, design, build and validation phases. Strong experience in supporting FO users and resolving their daily issues. 2+ years experience on Murex with ERM, Va R, and Risk functionalities/module. Good verbal and written communication skills. Strong organization skills. Nice to have BS or higher degree in Finance, Mathematics or equivalent. Experience with implementations and upgrades of Murex. Test management. Trade life cycle management. Market Data management. Knowledge in SQL (Oracle and/or Sybase) and Unix commands. Communication skills: expresses ideas effectively, both verbally and in writing; adjusts language, terminology and non‑verbal communication as appropriate. Teamwork: works effectively with others; helps to build strong teams and networks. Personal leadership: realistically identifies own skills, experience, knowledge and other personal attributes; displays confidence and resilience. Planning and organizing: identifies and meets milestones; understands and articulates deliverables; assesses and mitigates risks; sticks to the scope of work and manages any changes. Analytical decision‑making: identifies and solves problems using insight and experience to make good decisions; gathers relevant information, identifying important issues and drawing conclusions. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Qc analyst - audio content - brazil
description:
About Us

Pocket FM is the world’s largest audio-series platform, where powerful stories travel effortlessly across languages, cultures, and continents. From India and the US to Europe and beyond, we are redefining how stories are created, discovered, and experienced across the globe, without screens.

At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a deeply human-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. Our proprietary AI systems work alongside writers, voice artists, and creative teams to help stories scale globally, faster, smarter, and with cultural depth and emotional integrity intact.

Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250+ million listeners, 300,000+ creators, and 100,000+ audio series. With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing media-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide.

Role Overview

As a QC Analyst - Audio Content, you will be responsible for reviewing and ensuring the quality, accuracy, and consistency of audio files across different stages of production. This includes raw voice files submitted by voice-over artists and mastered audio files (with SFX and music) delivered by agencies. You will work closely with voice artists, agencies, and internal teams to ensure all audio content aligns with scripts, quality guidelines, and storytelling objectives.

Key Responsibilities

1. Audio Quality Control (Raw & Mastered Files) Review raw voice-over recordings to ensure clarity, acting, delivery, pronunciation, tone, pacing, and adherence to script. Evaluate mastered audio files (SFX + background music) for overall listening experience, sound ambiences, balance, and quality standards. Ensure all audio assets meet defined QC guidelines and Specs before approval.

2. Script-to-Audio Alignment Verify that audio delivery accurately follows the approved script, including dialogue, tone, and emotional expression. Identify and flag mismatches, missing lines, or deviations in narration.

3. Technical & Creative Accuracy Check audio for: Voice clarity and consistency Emotional delivery and storytelling effectiveness Background noise or distortions Timing and pacing issues Proper integration of SFX and music in mastered files Grammatically incorrect words/sentences Physical noise of voice artist Abrupt cut / jerk Sibilance Fumble / mumble

4. Vendor & Artist Coordination Collaborate with voice-over artists and external agencies to communicate QC feedback. Ensure timely implementation of revisions and re-submissions.

5. QC Documentation & Tracking Provide detailed QC feedback at timecode (TC) level. Update QC comments and statuses in internal tools or Excel trackers based on show type (AI and PGC content). Maintain records for submissions, revisions, approvals, and delivery timelines.

6. Pre-Release Quality Checks Ensure all audio files are QC-approved before publishing or release on the platform. Validate that final output meets both technical and creative standards.

7. Cross-Team Collaboration Work closely with writers, production teams, post production agencies, and content managers to ensure seamless audio quality. Align with internal guidelines and storytelling expectations across shows.

8. Process Improvement Identify recurring audio quality issues across voice artists or agencies. Recommend improvements to QC processes, guidelines, and production workflows. Understand how an audience reacts to certain genres of content to connect with the audience Stay abreast with changes in the voice requirements and technology

9. Volume & Deadline Management Handle QC for approximately 80 hours of audio content within defined timelines. Maintain high-quality standards while managing large volumes of content.

10. AI Voice Quality Review & Enhancement

Review AI-generated voice content to identify issues impacting listener experience, including but not limited to:

Accent inconsistencies and unnatural speech patterns Mispronunciations and incorrect word stress Lack of emotion, expression, or character differentiation Robotic delivery, pacing irregularities, or unnatural pauses Voice continuity and tonal inconsistencies across episodes Contextually inappropriate emphasis or dialogue delivery

Perform basic audio patchwork and corrective edits using approved audio editing tools to address identified issues wherever feasible.

Document AI voice-related observations with clear, actionable feedback at the time-code level and track recurring issues to support model improvements and production quality enhancements.

Collaborate with AI production, content, and post-production teams to ensure continuous improvement in AI-generated audio quality and listener engagement.

Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Audio Engineering, Media, Communications, or a related field. Strong understanding of audio production, voice modulation, and sound design basics. Experience in audio quality control, podcast production, or voice-over review is preferred. Familiarity with audio editing tools (Audition, Audacity, or similar) is a plus. Ability to review both AI-generated and professionally generated (PGC) content. Excellent attention to detail and auditory judgment. Strong organizational and documentation skills. Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced production environment. Proficiency in audio editing tools such as Adobe Audition, Audacity, or similar software for basic audio corrections and patchwork.

Language requirements Fluent Portugese Professional working proficiency in English

This role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis.

Salary for this position is R$ $3800 - $4100 BRL.

title: Operations lead
description:
About Perk Up

Perk Up is a fast-growing HR Tech startup disrupting the $242 B corporate gifting industry. Our platform lets employers send high-quality swag, gifts, gift cards, and rewards to employees globally—with on-demand fulfillment, 9 warehouses across 4 continents, and 60+ HRIS integrations. To learn more, visit .

We are seeking an Operations Lead to own and continuously improve the flow of products through our global fulfillment network—from the purchasing handoff through receiving, inventory, fulfillment, and delivery. You will be the primary point of contact for our 3 PLs, directly lead one operations coordinator from day one, and personally handle a meaningful share of the execution.

This is a hands-on player-coach role. You will create and review ASNs, follow up on inbound shipments, resolve inventory and order issues, coordinate process changes and system migrations, and make sure work does not become orphaned after it is delegated.

The right person is smart, ambitious, technically curious, and highly accountable. You do not need a perfect background in every tool or workflow, but you must learn quickly, think clearly when the process breaks, and push problems to resolution without waiting for step-by-step direction.

This role is fully remote and works a full Eastern Time schedule.

What you’ll own Own day-to-day relationships with our global 3 PL partners, including SLAs, escalations, performance, onboarding, and migrations. Directly manage and develop one operations coordinator through clear goals, delegation, review, coaching, and accountability. Create and review ASNs, follow up on inbound shipments, resolve receiving discrepancies, and protect inventory accuracy. Coordinate closely with the purchasing team to ensure a clean handoff from purchase order through warehouse availability. Monitor fulfillment and delivery, investigate exceptions and aging orders, and drive issues through resolution. Diagnose Shopify, WMS, and order-sync problems; gather evidence, coordinate with partners and engineering, and validate the fix. Lead new warehouse requirements, process changes, documentation, SOPs, dashboards, and operating controls. Track performance, identify recurring failure points, and build systems that reduce escalations and founder involvement.

What success looks like Fulfillment, receiving, ASN, and inventory accuracy improve measurably. Operational issues have clear owners, move quickly, and do not get lost between teams or vendors. Your direct report and 3 PL partners operate with stronger consistency, accountability, and independence. Perk Up’s fulfillment operation scales without requiring daily founder involvement.

What we’re looking for 3+ years of experience in logistics, supply chain, fulfillment, ecommerce, marketplace, or another complex operations environment. A track record of independently solving ambiguous operational problems and taking accountability for outcomes. Experience directly managing or materially leading another operator. Strong systems and technical aptitude—you can understand data flows, troubleshoot integrations, and communicate effectively with technical teams. Excellent written and spoken English; full professional fluency is required. Strong communication and vendor-management skills across remote teams. Active, sophisticated use of AI tools to research, analyze, document, and move faster—while verifying the output. A player-coach mindset: willing to do the work yourself, raise the bar for others, and stay effective under pressure. Goal-oriented, competitive, and motivated by increasing responsibility, impact, and career growth. Shopify and ASN experience are preferred, but neither is a hard requirement if you can demonstrate exceptional learning speed and relevant systems thinking.

Role details Location: Remote, Latin America Schedule: Full-time, working Eastern Time Engagement: Full-time contractor $4,500–$5,000 USD per month

Growth path

This role is designed for someone who wants to grow with the company. Strong performance can lead to broader ownership and a path toward Head of Operations and, over time, senior operations leadership as Perk Up scales.

title: Hunter, seller acquisition
description:
ABOUT SHEIN

SHEIN is a global online fashion and lifestyle retailer, offering SHEIN branded apparel and products from global network of vendors, all at affordable prices. Headquartered in Singapore, SHEIN remains committed to making the beauty of fashion accessible to all, promoting its industry-leading, on demand production methodology, for a smarter, future-ready industry. Founded in 2012, SHEIN has more than 16,000 employees operating from offices around the world, and continues to expand operations globally. Join SHEIN and be the future!

ABOUT THE ROLE

You will manage the acquisition and enablement of new sellers, providing tools, training, and support to maximize seller performance, drive retention, and expand the product catalog.

This role will be based in our office in São Paulo/Faria Lima. We are working 100% on-site.

Responsibilities: New Sellers: Proactively prospect and cultivate relationships with potential sellers, converting prospects into active partners that contribute to category growth. Account Activation: Lead the end-to-end process of new seller accounts and their product listings to ensure compliance with SHEIN's policies and standards. Publishing Guidance: Train new sellers on the SHEIN seller interface and guide them until they publish the minimum required number of product listings (specify number if desired). Cross-Departmental Collaboration: Partner with Hunting Support, Account Management, and Data Analytics to increase new-seller acquisition and onboarding effectiveness. Onboarding & Activation KPIs: Own key onboarding metrics for new sellers (conversion-to-onboard, time-to-onboard, time-to-minimum-catalog) and report progress to stakeholders to drive accountability and continuous improvement. Training & Enablement: Create and maintain comprehensive onboarding materials, host webinars and self‑service resources (step‑by-step guides, recorded videos, FAQs), provide live Q& A sessions, and reduce time-to-first-listing.

Qualifications: Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, E‑Commerce, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Experience: At least 1 year of experience in e‑commerce, product management, marketplace operations, or a related field. Technical Skills: Experience with CRM and product-management tools (e.g., Salesforce, Zendesk) and understanding of e‑commerce platforms. Competencies: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, excellent communication and collaboration abilities, and a proactive approach to process improvement. Languages: Fluency in English and Portuguese; knowledge of Mandarin is a plus.

At SHEIN, we believe that diversity is the force that drives innovation. We are committed to creating an environment where all voices are heard, valued and respected. All our vacancies are inclusive for people with disabilities, women, black people, LGBTQIAPN+ community and all types of diversity.
